description: Modern React + Tailwind AI-powered restaurant management SaaS dashboard

requirements.title: Public Landing Page
requirements.description: A public marketing landing page with hero section, problem section, solution section, and CTA. Hero contains title 'AI Revenue & Voice Copilot for Restaurants', subtitle, Login and Sign Up buttons. The page must render at route /.

requirements.title: Authentication - Login
requirements.description: A login page at /login with email and password fields. On submitting any email/password combination, wait 800ms and redirect to /dashboard. No real backend validation. A loading spinner shows during redirect.

requirements.title: Authentication - Signup
requirements.description: A signup page at /signup with name, email, password fields. On submit redirect to /dashboard after 900ms. No backend validation required.

requirements.title: Dashboard Overview Page
requirements.description: After login at /dashboard, show 4 KPI cards: Total Orders Today (147), Total Revenue (₹58,420), Avg Order Value (₹397), Top Selling Item (Paneer Pizza). Show Orders Over Time area chart, Top Selling Items bar chart, Weekly Revenue bar chart. All data is mocked.

requirements.title: Application Navigation
requirements.description: A sidebar navbar with links: Dashboard (/dashboard), Orders (/dashboard/orders), Voice Ordering (/dashboard/voice), Analytics (/dashboard/analytics). Logout button returns to /. Active link is highlighted. On mobile shows hamburger menu.

requirements.title: Orders Management Page
requirements.description: At /dashboard/orders, show a table with columns: Order ID, Items, Price, Status, Source. Status filter buttons for All/Received/Preparing/Ready/Served. Click a row to open a Kitchen Order Ticket side panel showing order items and an AI Upsell Recommendation card with Apriori analysis badge.

requirements.title: Voice Ordering Page
requirements.description: At /dashboard/voice, show a microphone button. On click, simulate voice ordering: show animated transcript ('Ek paneer pizza aur ek coke dena'), detect items (Paneer Pizza, Coke), show AI upsell suggestion (Add Garlic Bread), show order summary, allow confirming order.

requirements.title: Analytics Page
requirements.description: At /dashboard/analytics, show a Recharts scatter plot for Menu Profitability (Margin vs Popularity with color-coded quadrants), a Combo Recommendations table with confidence bars (Apriori results), an Underperforming Items table with action recommendations, and 4 summary stat cards.

requirements.title: SPA Routing - Direct URL Navigation
requirements.description: All routes must work on direct URL navigation (no page-not-found for /dashboard, /dashboard/orders, /dashboard/voice, /dashboard/analytics). React Router handles client-side routing. Server serves index.html for all routes.
